 Gonçalo Ramos’ injury opens the door for Italian youngsters at Milan 
 By Lorenzo Bettoni 
 Oct 22, 2026 12:29 
 ITALY - OCTOBER 18: Goncalo Ramos of AC Milan celebrates scoring his team’s first goal during the Serie A match between AC Milan and Atalanta BC at Stadio Giuseppe Meazza on October 18, 2026 in Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images) 
 Alphadjo Cisse will replace Gonçalo Ramos in Milan’s attack against Bournemouth , but the Portuguese international’s injury could open the door for another young Italian player, Francesco Camarda.
 Milan visit Bournemouth in Europa League Round 3 this evening, but the Rossoneri have been forced to travel to England without their injured striker, Ramos.
